cues: Kate Chopin was born in eighteen fifty in St. Louis.
Her father died when she was five, and she grew up in a house run by women: her mother, grandmother and great grandmother.
She married and moved to Louisiana, was widowed in eighteen eighty two, and began writing in her late thirties.
This story first appeared in Vogue magazine in eighteen ninety four.

Her novel The Awakening, about a wife who leaves her husband, was attacked as indecent in eighteen ninety nine, and her career never recovered, until critics rediscovered her in the twentieth century.
